title: Arkret InclusionList
description: FOCIL-style control-plane inclusion list. A non-proposer notary signer lists pending Control Move digests that passed its local verification; the next Seal MUST include, signed-reject, or prove batch pre-state verification failure for every listed digest, otherwise receivers MUST reject that Seal (authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 7.3). single_did notary profiles cannot provide this mechanism. The list is an accountability object, not a Seal: it never advances governance state by itself.

signer_id.description: Notary signer issuing the list. MUST be an eligible non-proposer signer of the Realm's multi-signer notary profile at issue time.

list_seq.description: Per-signer monotonic inclusion-list sequence. Two different canonical lists from the same signer with the same (realm_id, list_seq) constitute equivocation evidence under the section 7.1 slot rule.

event_digests.description: Canonical ascending list of pending Control Move event digests that passed the issuer's local verification and hold a valid receipt.

expiry_seal_count.description: Number of subsequent Seals within which the obligation must be discharged. Default deployment value is 1 (the next Seal).

payload_digest.description: Hash of canonical InclusionList bytes with signature omitted.
